query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN product_class = 'monoterpene' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as monoterpenes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN product_class = 'sesquiterpene' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sesquiterpenes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN product_class = 'diterpene' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as diterpenes
FROM tps_genes;
